description: Save a PAPER/TESTNET exchange's API keys to your account and link them to a webhook, in one step -- for an agent that has a practice account's keys and no browser. Only ALPACAPAPER, BINANCEDELIVERYTESTNET, BINANCEFUTURESTESTNET, BINANCETEST, BITGETDEMO, BITGETMIXDEMO, BITMEXTESTNET, BYBITCOPYTESTNET, BYBITSPOTTESTNET, BYBITTESTNET, CAPITALDEMO, CRYPTODEMO, DERIBITTESTNET, GATEFUTURESTESTNET, GEMINISANDBOX, HYPERLIQUIDTESTNET, OANDAPRACTICE, OKXDEMO, OKXEEADEMO, OKXUSDEMO, TRADOVATESIM are accepted (they never move real money); real-money exchanges are refused whatever your token's scope, and their keys must be added on autoview.com in a browser (see connect). The credentials object uses named keys (public, private, passphrase, email, vault, id, cid, sec); which of them an exchange takes, and what each is called on that exchange, is in catalog({ exchange }): its credentials schema lists the exact keys (titles are the exchange's own labels) and which are required. The keys are encrypted and stored exactly as the website's setup form stores them, and are never echoed back. hook_id, if given, must be one of your own hooks with no exchange linked yet (an order fires on every exchange a hook links); omit it to use an empty hook of yours or get a new one. Then call entry with the returned hook_id (dry-run by default) to check the keys work. Requires your Autoview account token; any token can link a paper exchange.

credentials.description: the practice account's keys, one string per field: fill only the fields the chosen exchange takes. The credentials object uses named keys (public, private, passphrase, email, vault, id, cid, sec); which of them an exchange takes, and what each is called on that exchange, is in catalog({ exchange }): its credentials schema lists the exact keys (titles are the exchange's own labels) and which are required.

private.description: ALPACAPAPER: Secret Key; BINANCEDELIVERYTESTNET: Secret; BINANCEFUTURESTESTNET: Secret; BINANCETEST: Secret; BITGETDEMO: Secret Key; BITGETMIXDEMO: Secret Key; BITMEXTESTNET: Secret; BYBITCOPYTESTNET: Private Key; BYBITSPOTTESTNET: Private Key; BYBITTESTNET: Private Key; CAPITALDEMO: Custom Password; CRYPTODEMO: Secret Key; DERIBITTESTNET: Access Secret; GATEFUTURESTESTNET: API Secret; GEMINISANDBOX: API Secret; HYPERLIQUIDTESTNET: Secret Key; OANDAPRACTICE: Access Token; OKXDEMO: Secret Key; OKXEEADEMO: Secret Key; OKXUSDEMO: Secret Key; TRADOVATESIM: Password

public.description: ALPACAPAPER: API Key ID; BINANCEDELIVERYTESTNET: API Key; BINANCEFUTURESTESTNET: API Key; BINANCETEST: API Key; BITGETDEMO: Access API Key; BITGETMIXDEMO: Access API Key; BITMEXTESTNET: ID; BYBITCOPYTESTNET: API Key; BYBITSPOTTESTNET: API Key; BYBITTESTNET: API Key; CAPITALDEMO: API Key; CRYPTODEMO: API Key; DERIBITTESTNET: Access Key; GATEFUTURESTESTNET: API Key; GEMINISANDBOX: API Key; HYPERLIQUIDTESTNET: Public Address (optional); OKXDEMO: API Key; OKXEEADEMO: API Key; OKXUSDEMO: API Key; TRADOVATESIM: Username

exchange.description: the paper/testnet exchange these keys belong to

hook_id.description: link this specific hook of yours (it must have no exchange linked yet); omit to use an empty hook or create a new one

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).
